summary: Graph API v20.0 removed; calls fall forward to the next version
details:
Graph API v20.0 was deprecated and removed on 2026-09-24. Calls pinned to v20.0 do not fail: they are served by the next oldest usable version, so response shapes can change silently.

Move the version segment to a supported version (v22.0 or later) and re-test the fields you read.
